screens.title: 1 · Agora, late
screens.why: A late block says how late; finishing is the obvious answer, on the right like the ✓.

pins.label: Atraso no término
pins.text: Replaces the progress bar and the 'atrasado' tag: dangerInk line with the warning mark, minutes from overtimeMinutes.

pins.label: Terminei, right
pins.text: The one accent button, white label on the red (onAccent), filling the row on the right, where the running card's ✓ sits. Posts /done.

pins.label: +10 min, left
pins.text: Outlined, on the left (extend). Pause and −10 are left out while late.

screens.title: 2 · Tap on an end reminder
screens.why: The tap opens the question in the app, with the reminder's answers.

pins.label: Head
pins.text: Hours (ink3), the card's title, the question. Late: 'Atraso no término · N minutos' in red instead.

pins.label: Mais 10 min · Terminei
pins.text: One row: outlined /extend on the left, accent /done on the right, as on the card.

pins.label: Falar com a Lunna
pins.text: Tertiary, the crescent (AppIcons.agent): opens the agent about the card.

screens.title: 3 · A task's start
screens.why: The card's own words for beginning or waiting.

pins.label: Esperar 10 min · Começar
pins.text: Outlined /snooze on the left, ▶ /tasks/:id/start on the right. Dismissing answers nothing.

screens.title: 4 · A fixed block's start
screens.why: It starts anyway; +10 moves it, so it says adiar.

pins.label: Adiar 10 min · Confirmar
pins.text: Outlined /events/:id/delay on the left, ▶ /events/:id/start on the right.

screens.title: 5 · One reminder on the Lock Screen
screens.why: Title is the card, body one plain question; the old ones are cleared.

pins.label: Card · question
pins.text: 'Fazendo a Lunna' — 'Terminando agora, certo?'. No buttons: a tap opens the sheet.

pins.label: Only the newest
pins.text: Delivered reminders older than the newest are removed whenever the app runs; one re-ask per edge, not two.
